transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this pre-lock meeting started. We've got the closing ceremony on Saturday evening in the main outdoor plaza, and the current draft has a 20-minute full-band finale with 10 dancers and an audience singalong. Before I sign off on the final production package, I need both of you to report any production constraints. Technical Director, let's start with you -- what are you seeing on the technical side? And Artist Liaison, I'll need your input as well. Once I've heard from both of you, I can approve the package, including any revisions we need to make based on what comes up.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical constraint from this morning's stage inspection. The signed engineering report just came in, and it changes our finale configuration significantly. The approved finale setup allows for exactly 8 dancers -- not 10. It also requires a 4-meter clear performance lane, and all dancers must stay on the reinforced deck section. The current draft's 10-dancer layout is not approved because its load and movement pattern exceed what the signed engineering plan can safely support. We'll need to revise the production package to bring it in line with these engineering constraints before it can be approved.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a critical constraint to report from the artist side. I confirmed with the headliner's manager after rehearsal that the headliner can only perform a seated acoustic finale with exactly 5 musicians for 12 minutes, and the audience must not be invited to sing along. This update came in after the draft run-of-show had already circulated, so the current draft's 20-minute full-band finale with audience singalong is not feasible.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Reduce dancer count from 10 to 8, maintain 4-meter clear performance lane, and keep all dancers on the reinforced deck section per the signed engineering report.
Change finale to seated acoustic format with exactly 5 musicians for 12 minutes, with no audience singalong per the headliner's manager.
